hints.title: Base Popcount Depth Mapping
hints.text: Set depth of one to zero and define depth for larger numbers as one plus the depth of their set bit count.

hints.title: Dynamic Programming Table
hints.text: Precompute bit counts and popcount depths sequentially from two up to n.

hints.title: Filter Target Depths
hints.text: Count how many integers in the range have depth equal to target k.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear dynamic programming table mapping popcount recurrence.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-evaluating popcount chains from scratch per number performs redundant calculations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Depth lookup array memoizes chain lengths in linear space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that popcount reduces numbers logarithmically, enabling memoized DP.
